subject: FinBridge connector trial — implementation & success gates
messages:
From: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@finbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pablo Santos <pablo.santos@finbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: FinBridge trial kickoff — recap + ask for implementation plan

Thanks for the demo this morning — quick recap from our side and the items we need to get the trial (connector + streaming) moving. High level: we want to validate integration latency and extraction fidelity for transaction enrichment (merchant normalization + category suggestions) across a 3-week trial.

Scope we agreed on:
- Connector: streaming ingest from our telemetry topic (Kafka) into Redwood API routes (streaming).
- SDK: embed Redwood client in our enrichment microservice (Node).
- Tool calling: allow the enrichment service to call back to a small set of custom tools for merchant lookup (we provided API previously).
- Success gates: 1) median end-to-end latency < 250ms for 95th percentile, 2) merchant normalization F1 >= 0.88 vs our labeled set, 3) stable KV cache hit rate >= 65% after warmup.

What we need from Redwood this week:
1) Implementation playbook (owner assignments, API routes, streaming handshake, sample code for Node SDK + streaming consumer).
2) A short runbook for test credential generation and expected message formats.
3) Confirmation of who will be the SE on our integration and a proposed kickoff date for the technical sync (we prefer next Thursday 9/21).

Attachments: FinBridge_POC_Implementation_Plan_v1.pdf, FinBridge_API_Routes_Map.xlsx (we've attached our data sample separately via Drive).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call to walk the plan if helpful.

— Ana Ruiz
Head of Platform Engineering, FinBridge
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@finbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinBridge trial kickoff — recap + ask for implementation plan

Ana — great to sync, thanks for the clear success gates. We're aligned internally and will own delivery on the items below. Quick responses and owners: 

- Implementation playbook & API routes: Karthik (SE) will draft the technical sheet and example Node SDK snippet.
- Credentials & message formats: Marissa (Integration Ops) will prepare the test credential runbook and sample JSON schemas.
- SE ownership and kickoff: Karthik will be SE lead; Ben will be your AM for trial coordination and SOW/contract items. I'll oversee the trial on our side.

Proposed next steps (we'll action immediately):
1) Karthik to produce a prioritized implementation checklist (streaming handshake, topic ACLs, sample payloads) by EOD Wed 9/13.
2) Marissa to share test-credential instructions + expected message examples by Thu 9/14.
3) Technical kickoff (30m) — proposal: Thu 9/21 10:00am PT. If that works for FinBridge we'll send calendar invite and a short agenda (handshake, auth, SDK demo, success gate measurement plan).
4) We will ingest your Drive sample as soon as you confirm path and will set up a temporary staging topic for end-to-end tests.

A few clarifying Qs from our side:
- Do you want us to host the tool-calling proxy (for merchant lookup) inside your VPC or can calls go out to your public API? (We can support both; VPC preferred for security).
- For the F1 measurement, do you want Redwood to run the evaluation on our side with your labeled set or will FinBridge host the eval and share a report?

We'll attach the first-draft implementation checklist to the calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Evelyn Hart
Director, Solutions (Redwood Inference)
From: Pablo Santos <pablo.santos@finbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@finbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinBridge trial kickoff — recap + ask for implementation plan

Evelyn, Ben — thanks for the quick turn. A couple quick clarifications from our infra/security team:

- We prefer the tool-calling traffic remain inside our VPC. We'll provide a private endpoint and a short-lived cert for the trial.
- We can host the labeled eval (for merchant normalization) and share results, but it'd help if Redwood can provide a simple evaluation harness (script + expected metrics) so we measure the same way.
- We'll upload a 48-hour sample of production anonymized telemetry to the Drive link today (sent separately).

Confirming the 3-week trial window: preferred run from Mon 9/25 — Fri 10/13. If that shifts anything on your side please flag.

Forwarded message follows:
> On Tue, Sep 12, 2028 at 11:02 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Ana — great to sync, thanks for the clear success gates. We're aligned internally and will own delivery on the items below.
> > — Evelyn

We'll aim to have the private endpoint details and eval hosting instructions by EOD Thu 9/14.

— Pablo Santos
CTO, FinBridge
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@finbridge.com>, Pablo Santos <pablo.santos@finbridge.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinBridge trial kickoff — implementation checklist & next steps

Ana / Pablo — quick check-in and timeline confirmation. Thanks for confirming dates — we can run 9/25–10/13 as proposed. Action items on our side (owners and ETA):

- Karthik (SE) — technical checklist + Node SDK streaming example + sample function-calling snippet (deliverable: 2028-09-13 EOD).
- Marissa (Integration Ops) — credential runbook, staging topic, and ACL setup instructions (deliverable: 2028-09-14 EOD).
- Evelyn (Director oversight) — trial SLOs and measurement plan (deliverable: 2028-09-16).
- Ben (AM) — calendar invite for technical kickoff Thu 9/21 10:00am PT + HubSpot deal updates and SOW/PO next steps.

Checklist highlights we'll cover in kickoff:
- Auth & handshake: topic ACLs, service accounts, short-lived certs for VPC tool calls.
- Streaming route: kafka -> Redwood ingress -> streaming route -> Node SDK consumer example.
- Tool calling: example proxy flow (VPC endpoint) and retry/fallback policy.
- Observability: token-level latency breakdown, KV cache heatmap, and per-route error counts.
- Eval harness: small script we run against your labeled set so metrics are comparable (we'll share GitHub gist in the invite).

Attachments: FinBridge_POC_Implementation_Plan_v1.pdf, FinBridge_API_Routes_Map.xlsx (attached). Internal reference: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/finbridge-poc (link for our ops team).

If any of these owners need to shift timing because of holidays or other conflicts, flag asap. Otherwise we'll send invites and deliverables as listed.

— Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
